meta.description: Hand-curated vulnerability -> function mapping for the PoC. In production this curation is the acknowledged cost center (per research conclusion); here it is curated manually for the sample CVEs, which is a legitimate PoC practice. See README.md in this directory.

functions.name: inflate
functions.note: EXTRA state: when the gzip header's extra field is longer than the space reserved by inflateGetHeader(), inflate() over-reads/over-writes heap memory. Reaching inflate() on a gzip stream with FEXTRA set exercises the vulnerable code path.
